digest.component_or_area: completion verifier step budget and verdict caching
propositions: Step budget exhausts on legitimate validation of multi-criteria tickets (especially epics with many children), causing false UNMET failures despite sufficient tool allowance, driving operators toward attestation laundering.
Budget formula lacks evidence-surface scaling term; it does not account for child-ticket traversal costs (5-10 requests per child), leading to undersized floors on hierarchical stories.
Every re-verify re-proves all criteria from scratch due to lack of cross-run PASS-verdict caching, causing ~10 min repeated cycles despite identical validation scope.

Cached PASS verdicts must be scoped to file-impact content (git blob SHAs) and criterion text, not whole-tree HEAD sha, so that unrelated commits or --ref-targeted verifies do not invalidate proven verdicts.
Seeded verdicts from cache must be excluded from primary work surface and protected from finalizer downgrade, preserving credited verdicts across runs while same-run downgrades remain honored.
